_about: FEAT-261024-06 (was FEAT-261024-04) / PAR-261023-01 section 3.3: shared cases for partitionWithUnread, MIRROR semantics. An unread chat keeps its own row in its place (Pinned / group / date bucket, with its red dot) and also gets a mirror row in the Unread section, id unread:<sessionId>. Both rows read one unread state; once it is gone the mirror row stays, read (readAt), below the unread rows, until a return to the foreground (or a cold start) finds it read more than 15 minutes ago, or the chat runs for 300 ms (FEAT-261025-01). readAt is optional, {id: readAt}; a read row has read=true; readCount counts them (at most 10, outside maxVisible). lifecycle cases replay events through UnreadRetention.reduce (unread, read, markAllRead, undo, runStart, runEnd, tick, foreground, coldStart) and expect the resulting unread, readAt and the partition's section with default options. No lifted list, no group counts. Defaults: search=false, enabled=true, maxVisible=5, collapsed=false, showAll=false. source is none | pinned | folder:<id> (the label shows that folder's current name). Times are any monotonic number. mirrored lists every chat the section mirrors, hidden and folded ones included.

cases.name: no unread: no section
plain unread chat: mirrored, its own row stays where it is
cases.note: The partition never takes a chat out of its place; the list around the section is laid out as without it.

cases.name: unread in a group: mirror row labelled with the group
cases.note: The group card keeps its own rule (dot while folded) and its members; the partition has no group counts.

cases.name: pinned unread: labelled Pinned
pinned and in a group: the group wins
sub-agent chat is never mirrored
order: unreadAt desc
same unreadAt: updatedAt desc, then id
truncated at maxVisible: the rest behind Show N More, still mirrored
Show N More expanded
maxVisible 3
collapsed: no mirror rows, header keeps the count
collapsed and over the quota: no Show N More either
search hides the section; unread chats keep their dot in place
select mode hides the section (callers pass it as search)
cases.note: iOS passes searchActive = searching || selecting: one selectable row per chat.

cases.name: setting off: no section
read from either row and past its stay: no section
cases.note: Before: unread {A}. Opening A from its own row or from the mirror row clears the same state; both dots go. The read row then stays (case 28) until a return past 15 minutes, or a run, drops its readAt (lifecycle R4, R12).

cases.name: one of two read: only its mirror leaves
cases.note: Before: unread {A:100, B:200}. A read and gone from readAt (past its stay). Nothing else moves.

cases.name: read the newest of six: the oldest comes out from behind Show N More
cases.note: Before: A..F unread, F..B on screen, A behind Show 1 More. F read: A comes into view (an insert, not an arrival).

cases.name: Mark All as Read, past the stay: no section
cases.note: Right after Mark All as Read every row stays, read (lifecycle R10).

cases.name: Undo restores the old unread times, so the old order
a new reply to a chat already unread keeps its first unreadAt
cases.note: A got another reply at 300; the store keeps unreadAt 100, so A does not jump.

cases.name: ids no longer in the list are ignored
unknown group: pin or nothing
source label follows a rename (long names are cut by the view, not here)
maxVisible below 1 shows one
a duplicate session id is mirrored once
a read chat keeps its mirror row, read, below the unread ones
cases.note: A was read at 300 (after B turned unread); it still sits below B: unread rows always come first.

cases.name: only read rows: the section stays, header count 0
read rows: most recently read first
read rows do not count against the size; Show N More is unread rows only
at most 10 read rows (the most recently read)
an id both unread and read is unread
collapsed: no rows, read ones counted apart
search hides read rows too
setting off: no read rows either
a read sub-agent chat is never shown
a read chat no longer in the list is ignored
read rows keep their source label

lifecycle.name: in the foreground it never expires, however long
lifecycle.note: No timer: an hour in the foreground still shows the read row.

lifecycle.name: a return to the foreground within 15 minutes keeps it
a return past 15 minutes: it leaves
one return, two read rows: the old one leaves, the recent one waits for the next
cold start within 15 minutes: still shown (no entrance animation)
cold start past 15 minutes: not shown
unread again while kept: unread row again, new unreadAt, back on top
opening a kept chat again does not extend its stay
lifecycle.note: The second read is a no-op (the chat is not unread); the stay still counts from 200.

lifecycle.name: Mark All as Read: every row stays, read
lifecycle.note: Same readAt: updatedAt desc (B 20 > A 10), as for unread rows.

lifecycle.name: Undo: back to unread with the old times, no read rows
kept chat starts running: it leaves after the 300 ms debounce
lifecycle.note: Its own row stays where it is.

lifecycle.name: a running blip shorter than the debounce: it stays
still within the debounce: it stays
the run ends with a new reply: unread, back in as an unread row
an unread chat that starts running keeps its row
already running when read: the debounce counts from the read
lifecycle.note: Then a tick at 200.3 releases it (R12).

lifecycle.name: a run that ended before the return does not matter; the return judges by readAt
